Phone & Twilio
Configure your Twilio phone number, voicemail, and on-call routing
📞 Twilio — Calling & SMS
Configure Twilio for inbound call/SMS routing and outbound volunteer messaging. Get credentials at console.twilio.com.
Webhook URLs — set these in your Twilio number settings:
VOICE https://rolecall.hwtco.org/twilio/voice
SMS https://rolecall.hwtco.org/twilio/sms
In Twilio Console → Phone Numbers → your number → set "A call comes in" and "A message comes in" to Webhook, HTTP POST, and paste the URLs above.
Include country code e.g. +1
Calls/texts forward here when nobody is on call
Voice Greeting Messages
For each message, either type text (read by AI voice) or upload your own recording (MP3/WAV). Recording takes priority if both are set.
No text option here — audio only. Leave empty for silence.
Get from api.slack.com/apps → OAuth & Permissions → Bot User OAuth Token
Get this from api.slack.com/apps → HWTC Calls → Incoming Webhooks. Never share this URL publicly.
📅 Weekly On-Call Report
Auto-post the week's on-call schedule to Slack. You can also post manually from the On-Call Schedule page.
